description: Thresholds for tools/visual_regress.py. A golden set must be captured locally for the matching GPU, driver, operating system, and build; rendering and noise levels can differ between configurations.

title.note: PRESS ANY BUTTON title card: bright, near-greyscale, animated sparkle. Required: every run reaches it.

logo.note: BAYONETTA logo splash between the title and the main menu: bright purple logo on black.

main-menu.note: MAIN MENU (Story/Continue, Options): dark menu with a drifting mist background.

option-card.note: Naive Angel Mode / Cute Masking explanation card on first boot; close with B.

chapter-select.note: Chapter Select / difficulty (PROLOGUE, STANDARD) with an animated smoke background.

loading.note: White loading screen with the small purple emblem bottom right.

macos-moltenvk.notes: Capture a local baseline for the matching macOS, GPU, driver, and build. Required scenes fail the run when missing; optional scenes are checked only when present. Do not reuse baselines across different rendering configurations.

linux-amdgpu.notes: Capture a local baseline for the matching Linux, GPU, driver, and build. Do not reuse baselines across different rendering configurations.

windows.notes: Capture a local Windows baseline for the matching GPU, driver, and build; macOS baselines do not apply.
